name: The Runed Scroll
summary: Found in Kalimdor's wilds, The Runed Scroll bears a formal message from across the border. Its discovery sends Horde scouts to warn the guards at Mor'shan Rampart of activity to the north.

sections.title: A Silvery Ribbon
sections.body: A silvery ribbon binds the scroll, unlike the rough leathers and parchment common in the Barrens. Its craft and script point north, to the night elves beneath Ashenvale's canopies. The ridges and roads are contested, so a message taken from the enemy could matter greatly to the Horde's front lines.

sections.title: Eyes on the Northern Border
sections.body: The scroll belongs with local command, not in the Warchief's hall in Orgrimmar. Kadrak, an orc warrior, watches the border from Mor'shan Rampart, where the Barrens' red earth meets Ashenvale's forests. Bring the scroll to this outpost, and its guards will learn of night elf troop movements.

faq.answer: The Runed Scroll is finely made and bound with a silvery ribbon, its form pointing to night elf origins. It carries intelligence about their movements or plans along the Barrens border.

faq.q: Where should I take the scroll?
aliases: where do i take the runed scroll
faq.answer: Take the scroll to Kadrak at Mor'shan Rampart, the northern border post between the Barrens and Ashenvale.
Kadrak is a Horde scout and guard atop a defensive tower at Mor'shan Rampart. He watches for threats from Ashenvale.

faq.q: Why would the night elves drop a scroll in the Barrens?
faq.answer: Night elf sentinels and scouts patrol Ashenvale's borders and fringes. They sometimes venture south to test Horde defenses or ambush supply lines headed north.

faq.q: What happens after giving the scroll to Kadrak?
faq.answer: After reading the scroll, Kadrak names its author as Rynthariel, a dryad and Keymaster of the Talon Den. He sends you to Stonetalon Peak to kill her and plant a Horde flag in the den.

faq.q: Why does the scroll matter to the Horde?
faq.answer: Tensions between the Horde and night elves simmer over logging and borders. Intercepted messages can warn the Horde of Alliance ambushes against Mor'shan Rampart.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you know intercepted Alliance intelligence helps protect the lumber crews and border sentries guarding the gateway into Ashenvale.
As an orc, you know the Warsong Clan's expansion into Ashenvale depends on Mor'shan Rampart's defenses. Night elf messages carry vital news.
